title: Forest Service “restructuring” is bad news for public lands
content: The Trump administration's "restructuring" plans for the Forest Service will torpedo federal capacity to manage national forests, close regional offices, and shutter more than half of its research labs.

title: ‘Studies in Happiness’: What Japan can teach us about thriving beyond economic growth
content: While degrowth in Europe is often framed as a deliberate choice, Japan’s version is distinctive - and instructive. Japan offers a rare set of living experiments in how communities can actually function, and even thrive, without growth as the organizing goal.

title: Beyond the supermarket: What Greece’s alternative food networks teach us about degrowth
